teacher_intro.text: Okay class, you have mastered addition and subtraction. As we all know, four plus four is... who is going to tell me?

teacher_eight_close.text: Ooh, super close! Four plus four is eight.

teacher_q2.text: And what is five minus three?

teacher_two_close.text: Nice try! Five minus three is two.

captain_danger.text: There is grave danger in deep space. Earth needs its sharpest young minds. We are enrolling five cadets today.

teacher_names.text: Please stand when I call your name. Maya... Leo... Aarav... Zoe...

teacher_pick_generic.text: And our fifth cadet is... you!

captain_brief1.text: Welcome, cadets. You are going to be the protectors of Earth against enemies in space.

captain_brief2.text: You have a spaceship, your co-pilot, and plasma balls to clear every squadron. Remember, plasma cells are precious. Too few and invaders slip past. Too many and we burn extra fuel.

nova_hi.text: Hey! I am Nova, your co-pilot! Together we will calibrate every shot dead on. Ready for launch?

nova_l0_intro.text: Welcome to Cadet Bay! Drones fly in squadrons. Count every drone, load that many plasma balls, and fire!

nova_zero.text: Zero squads means empty space. Not a single invader!

nova_zero_ask.text: How many plasma balls do we need for empty space?

nova_mirror.text: One squad is just a mirror. It keeps the exact same number.

nova_mirror_repeat.text: Remember Empty and Mirror: times zero is zero, times one stays the same!

nova_over.text: Too many! The extra plasma balls flew past into space.

nova_under.text: Some drones slipped past! We need more plasma balls.

nova_retry.text: Shields are back up. Try that shot again!

nova_l0_clear.text: Cadet Bay is clear! The Moon is open. Let's fly!

nova_incoming.text: Squadrons incoming! One plasma ball for every drone.

principal_intro.text: Class, this is the Captain of the Star Fleet.

teacher_proud.text: Five cadets... from my class? Captain, I know exactly who you need.

captain_nova.text: And every pilot needs a co-pilot. Meet yours.
